    mod(extract(dayofweek from date_day) + 5, 7) + 1 as iso_day_of_week,

with tu as (
    select
        feed_ts_utc,
        entity_id as tu_entity_id,
        trip_id,
        route_id,
        stop_id,
        stop_sequence,
        arrival_delay_sec as arrival_delay_sec_raw,
        departure_delay_sec as departure_delay_sec_raw,
        schedule_relationship,
        event_ts_utc as tu_event_ts_utc
    from `whyline-denver`.`raw_denver`.`raw_gtfsrt_trip_updates`
    where feed_ts_utc >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 12 hour)
      and date(feed_ts_utc) >= date_sub(current_date(), interval 1 day)  -- Explicit partition filter
),
vp as (
    select
        feed_ts_utc,
        entity_id as vp_entity_id,
        trip_id,
        route_id,
        vehicle_id,
        vehicle_label,
        lon,
        lat,
        bearing,
        speed_mps,
        event_ts_utc as vp_event_ts_utc
    from `whyline-denver`.`raw_denver`.`raw_gtfsrt_vehicle_positions`
    where feed_ts_utc >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 12 hour)
      and date(feed_ts_utc) >= date_sub(current_date(), interval 1 day)  -- Explicit partition filter
),
j as (
    select
        coalesce(tu.feed_ts_utc, vp.feed_ts_utc) as feed_ts_utc,
        coalesce(tu.trip_id, vp.trip_id) as trip_id,
        coalesce(tu.route_id, vp.route_id) as route_id,
        tu.tu_entity_id,
        vp.vp_entity_id,
        tu.stop_id,
        tu.stop_sequence,
        tu.arrival_delay_sec_raw,
        tu.departure_delay_sec_raw,
        tu.schedule_relationship,
        vp.vehicle_id,
        vp.vehicle_label,
        vp.lon,
        vp.lat,
        vp.bearing,
        vp.speed_mps,
        
    ST_GEOGPOINT(CAST(vp.lon AS FLOAT64), CAST(vp.lat AS FLOAT64))
 as geom,
        coalesce(tu.tu_event_ts_utc, vp.vp_event_ts_utc, coalesce(tu.feed_ts_utc, vp.feed_ts_utc)) as event_ts_utc
    from tu
    full outer join vp
        on tu.feed_ts_utc = vp.feed_ts_utc
        and tu.trip_id = vp.trip_id
        and tu.route_id = vp.route_id
    -- A NULL trip_id never matches the MERGE key, so these rows were re-inserted every run
    where coalesce(tu.trip_id, vp.trip_id) is not null
),
ranked as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by feed_ts_utc, trip_id
            order by event_ts_utc desc, tu_entity_id desc, vp_entity_id desc
        ) as trip_rank
    from j
)

with versions as (
    
with versions_in as (
    select
        route_id,
        _extract_date,
        route_name, route_long_name, route_type, route_desc,
        to_json_string(struct(route_name, route_long_name, route_type, route_desc)) as attr_sig
    from (select * from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_gtfs_routes` where is_valid)
),
flagged as (
    select
        *,
        if(attr_sig = lag(attr_sig) over (partition by route_id order by _extract_date), 0, 1) as is_change
    from versions_in
),
numbered as (
    select
        *,
        sum(is_change) over (
            partition by route_id order by _extract_date rows unbounded preceding
        ) as version_num
    from flagged
),
grouped as (
    select
        route_id,
        version_num,
        any_value(route_name) as route_name,
        any_value(route_long_name) as route_long_name,
        any_value(route_type) as route_type,
        any_value(route_desc) as route_desc,
        min(_extract_date) as first_seen_extract,
        max(_extract_date) as last_seen_extract
    from numbered
    group by route_id, version_num
),
bounded as (
    select
        *,
        if(version_num = 1, date '1900-01-01', first_seen_extract) as valid_from,
        lead(first_seen_extract) over (partition by route_id order by version_num) as next_valid_from,
        max(last_seen_extract) over () as latest_extract
    from grouped
)
select
    farm_fingerprint(concat(cast(route_id as string), '|', cast(valid_from as string))) as route_key,
    route_id,
    route_name, route_long_name, route_type, route_desc,
    valid_from,
    case
        when next_valid_from is not null then date_sub(next_valid_from, interval 1 day)
        when last_seen_extract = latest_extract then date '9999-12-31'
        else last_seen_extract
    end as valid_to,
    next_valid_from is null and last_seen_extract = latest_extract as is_current,
    next_valid_from is null as is_latest_version,
    first_seen_extract,
    last_seen_extract
from bounded

)

),
trips as (

stop_times as (

    from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_gtfs_stop_times`
    where _extract_date >= date '2026-10-21'
),
file_extracts as (
    select
        'calendar' as gtfs_file,
        _extract_date,
        logical_and(is_valid) as all_valid,
        logical_or(is_valid) as any_valid
    from calendar
    group by _extract_date
    union all
    select
        'calendar_dates' as gtfs_file,
        _extract_date,
        logical_and(is_valid) as all_valid,
        logical_or(is_valid) as any_valid
    from calendar_dates
    group by _extract_date
    union all
    select
        'trips' as gtfs_file,
        _extract_date,
        logical_and(is_valid) as all_valid,
        logical_or(is_valid) as any_valid
    from trips
    group by _extract_date
    union all
    select
        'stop_times' as gtfs_file,
        _extract_date,
        logical_and(is_valid) as all_valid,
        logical_or(is_valid) as any_valid
    from stop_times
    group by _extract_date
),
good_snapshots as (
    select _extract_date
    from file_extracts
    group by _extract_date
    having logical_and(all_valid)
),
date_candidates as (
    select
        service_date,
        max(if(g._extract_date <= service_date, g._extract_date, null)) as prev_snapshot,
        min(if(g._extract_date > service_date, g._extract_date, null)) as next_snapshot
    from unnest(generate_date_array(
        current_date('America/Denver'),
        date_add(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 30 day)
    )) as service_date
    cross join good_snapshots as g
    group by service_date
),
date_snapshot as (
    -- Preference 1: latest snapshot on or before the date; 2: the next one
    select
        dc.service_date,
        candidate.snapshot_date,
        candidate.preference
    from date_candidates as dc
    cross join unnest([
        struct(dc.prev_snapshot as snapshot_date, 1 as preference),
        struct(dc.next_snapshot as snapshot_date, 2 as preference)
    ]) as candidate
    where candidate.snapshot_date is not null
),
date_extract as (
    -- Per file: latest valid extract on or before the snapshot (unchanged files are not reloaded)
    select
        ds.service_date,
        ds.preference,
        coalesce(
            max(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'calendar' and fe.any_valid and fe._extract_date <= ds.snapshot_date, fe._extract_date, null)),
            min(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'calendar' and fe.any_valid, fe._extract_date, null))
        ) as calendar_extract,
        coalesce(
            max(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'calendar_dates' and fe.any_valid and fe._extract_date <= ds.snapshot_date, fe._extract_date, null)),
            min(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'calendar_dates' and fe.any_valid, fe._extract_date, null))
        ) as calendar_dates_extract,
        coalesce(
            max(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'trips' and fe.any_valid and fe._extract_date <= ds.snapshot_date, fe._extract_date, null)),
            min(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'trips' and fe.any_valid, fe._extract_date, null))
        ) as trips_extract,
        coalesce(
            max(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'stop_times' and fe.any_valid and fe._extract_date <= ds.snapshot_date, fe._extract_date, null)),
            min(if(fe.gtfs_file = 'stop_times' and fe.any_valid, fe._extract_date, null))
        ) as stop_times_extract
    from date_snapshot as ds
    cross join file_extracts as fe
    group by ds.service_date, ds.preference
),
active_services as (
    select
        de.service_date,
        de.preference,
        de.trips_extract,
        de.stop_times_extract,
        c.service_id
    from date_extract as de
    join calendar as c
        on c._extract_date = de.calendar_extract
        and c.is_valid
        and de.service_date between c.start_date and c.end_date
        and case extract(dayofweek from de.service_date)
            when 1 then c.sunday
            when 2 then c.monday
            when 3 then c.tuesday
            when 4 then c.wednesday
            when 5 then c.thursday
            when 6 then c.friday
            when 7 then c.saturday
        end
    left join calendar_dates as removed
        on removed._extract_date = de.calendar_dates_extract
        and removed.service_id = c.service_id
        and removed.exception_date = de.service_date
        and removed.exception_type = 2
        and removed.is_valid
    where removed.service_id is null

    union distinct

    select
        de.service_date,
        de.preference,
        de.trips_extract,
        de.stop_times_extract,
        cd.service_id
    from date_extract as de
    join calendar_dates as cd
        on cd._extract_date = de.calendar_dates_extract
        and cd.exception_date = de.service_date
        and cd.exception_type = 1
        and cd.is_valid
),
chosen_services as (
    -- Use the next snapshot only when the preferred one runs no service that day

    from active_services
    qualify preference = min(preference) over (partition by service_date)

    select

        a.stop_times_extract,
        t.trip_id,
        t.route_id,
        t.direction_id,
        st.stop_id,
        st.stop_sequence,
        case
            when st.arrival_time is not null
                then 
timestamp(
    datetime(
        date_add(
            a.service_date,
            interval cast(floor(
                safe_cast(split(st.arrival_time, ':')[offset(0)] as int64) / 24
            ) as int64) day
        ),
        time(
            mod(
                safe_cast(split(st.arrival_time, ':')[offset(0)] as int64),
                24
            ),
            safe_cast(split(st.arrival_time, ':')[offset(1)] as int64),
            safe_cast(split(st.arrival_time, ':')[offset(2)] as int64)
        )
    ),
    "America/Denver"
)

        end as sched_arrival_ts_mst,
        case
            when st.departure_time is not null
                then 
timestamp(
    datetime(
        date_add(
            a.service_date,
            interval cast(floor(
                safe_cast(split(st.departure_time, ':')[offset(0)] as int64) / 24
            ) as int64) day
        ),

            ),
            safe_cast(split(st.departure_time, ':')[offset(1)] as int64),
            safe_cast(split(st.departure_time, ':')[offset(2)] as int64)
        )
    ),
    "America/Denver"
)

        end as sched_departure_ts_mst
    from chosen_services as a
    join trips as t
        on t._extract_date = a.trips_extract
        and t.service_id = a.service_id
        and t.is_valid
    join stop_times as st
